statement: For any finite forest, independent Bernoulli bonds with arbitrary edge probabilities, vertices o,b and nonempty relay set A, P(o↔b)>=P(o↔A) min_{a in A}P(a↔b); its sharp near-one modulus is 1-sqrt(1-epsilon).
assumptions: Finite forest; independent edge states; epsilon in (0,1); strict near-one premises.
source: w426/ATTEMPT.md L1-L3, owner-own-work; w428/ATTEMPT.md independent rederivation.
proof_or_counterexample: Choose relay with earliest median projection onto unique o-b path, concatenate open paths through its separator, then apply Harris positive association. The two-edge path realizes equality and sharpness.
remaining_gap: Does not give arbitrary cyclic graph gluing or a new proof of C0023.

statement: On the three-edge path o-a2-a1-b with relays ordered (a1,a2), replacing P(a↔b | selected relay a) by P(a↔b) can overstate terminal connection; at edge probability 1/2 the substituted sum is 3/16 while terminal probability is 1/8.
assumptions: Independent bonds; selected relay is first reachable in the fixed order (a1,a2); three edges each have probability 1/2 for the displayed constants.
source: w426/ATTEMPT.md B1, owner-own-work; w428/verify_review.py exact enumeration.
proof_or_counterexample: Selecting a2 forces middle edge closed, so its conditional chance to reach b is zero while its unconditional chance is 1/4; exact enumeration confirms the 1/16 excess.
remaining_gap: Does not refute sorted-relay arguments, probabilistic gluing, or C0023.

statement: For increasing subgraphs G_n exhausting a connected locally finite graph G at fixed Bernoulli bond p, theta_G(p)=inf_R sup_n P_p(o connects in G_n to ambient distance >=R), whereas theta_Gn(p)=inf_R P_p(o connects in G_n to ambient distance >=R).
assumptions: Common origin; vertex-and-edge exhaustion; ambient graph locally finite; R positive integer; fixed p.
proof_or_counterexample: Finite-path witnesses give increasing union over n at fixed R; local finiteness identifies infinite cluster with intersection over R; probability continuity gives the two formulas.
remaining_gap: Extinction in each G_n alone does not imply uniform ambient one-arm decay.

statement: At p=99/100 each finite-width strip S_k=Z×{-k,...,k} has no infinite Bernoulli bond cluster, but the union Z² has theta(p)>0.99999.
assumptions: Nearest-neighbor independent bonds; finite k; planar dual closed-circuit count.
source: w427/INDEPENDENT.md and ATTEMPT.md, owner-own-work; w428/verify_review.py exact rational check.
proof_or_counterexample: Independent all-closed column cuts yield strip p_c=1. A finite planar origin cluster implies a closed dual circuit; summing <=4m 3^(m-1)(1-p)^m for m>=4 gives 10557/2352250000<1/100000.
remaining_gap: Only refutes transfer without uniform or threshold-convergence hypotheses, not critical nonpercolation on Z^d.
